sentences.english: Just as my mother taught me to draw when I was a child, I will teach my children to draw too.
sentences.grammar_focus: كَما + a verbal sentence for "just as", عَلَّمَ with a feminine subject and an object pronoun (عَلَّمَتْني أُمّي الرَّسْمَ), كانَ + an accusative predicate (كُنْتُ طِفْلًا), and عَلَّمَ with two direct objects in the future (سَأُعَلِّمُ أَطْفالي الرَّسْمَ)

sentences.english: For a long period my grandfather owned a farm in the south of the country, where the whole family took part in the harvest.
